item.title: Top Trump administration official defends partial release of Epstein files as Democrats cry foul
item.description: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla. (AP) — Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche on Sunday defended the Justice Department’s decision to release just a fraction of the Jeffrey Epstein files by the congressionally mandated deadline as necessary to protect survivors of sexual abuse by the disgraced financier. Blanche pledged that the Trump administration eventually would meet its obligation required by law. […]

item.description: Holliday Park is hosting a skate with Santa today, giving people a chance to see Santa before Christmas and enjoy the Holiday Spirit.

item.title: Man found dead inside car near Fort Wayne gas station
item.description: A man was found dead in a car with a gunshot wound in Fort Wayne, Indiana early Sunday morning, and police are investigating the incident.

item.title: Colts offensive lineman ruled out for Monday’s game vs. 49ers
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts will be without offensive tackle Bernhard Raimann (elbow) on Monday night against the San Francisco 49ers.

item.title: Cold Sunday night then milder by the holidays | Dec. 21, 2025
item.description: Central Indiana is expected to experience a mild, wet holiday pattern with temperatures rising from the 40s to near 50, with occasional showers and wet roads, but no snow or ice.

item.title: Nearly 3 million Hoosiers expected to travel during holiday surge
item.description: Millions of Hoosiers are expected to join a record level of year-end holiday travel, with 2.9 million people from Indiana traveling from Dec. 20 through New Year's Day.

item.title: Indiana National guardsman’s wife stranded overseas due to new travel restrictions
item.description: Walter Moyoh, a member of the Indiana National Guard, is struggling to bring his pregnant wife to the U.S. due to expanded travel restrictions, leaving her stranded overseas and causing delays in the legal immigration process.
